In an undirected graph, (i,j) means that node i and node j are connected with an undirected edge.
The nodes are numbered from 0 to 8, and the edges are: (0,8) (0,4) (1,5) (1,2) (1,4) (2,6) (2,4) (2,8) (3,6) (3,4) (3,7) (3,5) (4,7) (4,8) (4,5) (5,6) (6,8) (7,8)
Q: Is there a path in this graph that visits every node exactly once? If yes, give the path. Note that in a path, adjacent nodes must be connected with edges.
A:

Return only a JSON object using this schema: {"path":[...]}. Do not output explanations.
